statusNotes: Categorical, following the World Bank regional report. 'context' marks demographic or usage indicators that are not a build status. Page references are printed page numbers (S1: PDF page minus 14; S4: PDF page minus 38; S6: PDF page minus 15; S2, S3, S5: same as PDF). No numeric score is computed. Source ids were renumbered in the second pass; see sources.md.
